name: Rule 1: Technical role granted to a user or group role
summary: Technical role granted to a user or group role. Why: Technical roles belong under functional roles only. Severity Medium (access.py:108).

name: Rule 2: Direct privilege on a functional role
summary: Direct privilege on a functional role. Why: Privileges sit on technical roles, so the role model stays reviewable. Severity Medium (access.py:108).

name: Rule 3: READ held directly and through another role
summary: READ held directly and through another role. Why: The direct grant is redundant and survives when the other one is removed. Severity Low (access.py:108).

name: Rule 4: OWNER role held by a consumer
summary: OWNER role held by a consumer. Why: Owners can drop and re-grant objects; only the build identity should own. Severity High (access.py:108).

name: Rule 5: Admin role held by a person
summary: Admin role held by a person. Why: Admin roles bypass the role model; use them through break-glass only. Severity High (access.py:108).

name: Rule 6: Sensitive column without a masking policy
summary: Sensitive column without a masking policy. Why: Everyone who can read the object sees the value in clear. Severity Medium (access.py:108).

name: Rule 7: Dormant or disabled person can read sensitive data
summary: Dormant or disabled person can read sensitive data. Why: Unused access to sensitive data is pure risk. Severity High (access.py:108).

name: Rule 8: Disabled user still holds roles
summary: Disabled user still holds roles. Why: Re-enabling the user brings all access back at once. Severity Low (access.py:108).

name: Rule 9: Privilege granted to PUBLIC
summary: Privilege granted to PUBLIC. Why: Every user, present and future, gets it. Severity High (access.py:109).

name: Rule 10: Person can write to a sensitive object
summary: Person can write to a sensitive object. Why: Writes to sensitive data should come from the build or a service user. Severity Medium (access.py:109).

name: Rule 11: Sensitive object reachable through a group role
summary: Sensitive object reachable through a group role. Why: Group membership is managed outside Snowflake, so reviews miss it. Severity Low (access.py:109).

name: Rule 12: Admin role is a user's default role
summary: Admin role is a user's default role. Why: Every session starts with admin rights. Severity High (access.py:109).

name: Rule 13: Orphan role: no users and no parent roles
summary: Orphan role: no users and no parent roles. Why: Unused roles hide access that nobody reviews. Severity Low (access.py:109).

name: Rule 14: f'Chain deeper than {MAX_DEPTH_RULE} roles'
summary: f'Chain deeper than {MAX_DEPTH_RULE} roles'. Why: Long chains are hard to review and hide where access comes from. Severity Low (access.py:109).

name: Rule 15: Future grant in a schema that holds sensitive data
summary: Future grant in a schema that holds sensitive data. Why: New tables there are readable before anyone classifies them. Severity Medium (access.py:109).

name: Rule 16: f'Dormant user (no login for {DORMANT_DAYS} days) still holds roles'
summary: f'Dormant user (no login for {DORMANT_DAYS} days) still holds roles'. Why: Unused accounts are an easy way in. Severity Medium (access.py:110).

name: Rule 17: Read-only role can write
summary: Read-only role can write. Why: The role name or its use says read-only, but it can change data. Severity High (access.py:110).

name: Rule 18: Unusual privilege set
summary: Unusual privilege set. Why: The role holds more or fewer privileges than its capability (READ, WRITE, ...) stands for, so its name no longer tells what it can do. Severity Low (access.py:110).

name: Rule 19: EXECUTE TASK held by a person or consumer role
summary: EXECUTE TASK held by a person or consumer role. Why: Running tasks belongs to the build or a service user. Severity Medium (access.py:110).

name: Rule 20: OPERATE on a task outside owner/build roles
summary: OPERATE on a task outside owner/build roles. Why: The task runs with its owner's privileges, so whoever can start or resume it borrows them. Severity High (access.py:110).

name: Rule 21: Warehouse MODIFY or OPERATE outside owner/build roles
summary: Warehouse MODIFY or OPERATE outside owner/build roles. Why: Resizing, suspending or resuming a warehouse changes cost and availability for everyone. Severity Medium (access.py:110).

name: Rule 22: Stream on sensitive table readable without the table
summary: Stream on sensitive table readable without the table. Why: A stream returns the table's changed rows, so it leaks data its reader cannot read in the table. Severity High (access.py:110).

name: Rule 23: CREATE privilege on a schema held by a read-only role
summary: CREATE privilege on a schema held by a read-only role. Why: A read-only role that can create objects can copy data or change the schema. Severity High (access.py:111).
